zh: 整个界面按新版式重做了一遍：列表直接铺在纸面上，用细线和左侧一道竖线分隔，不再一张张卡片套着；按钮、输入框、标签统一成胶囊形。八个页面都去掉了标题栏和副标题——页名侧栏和底栏已经写着，标题只是重复，白占一整条高度。词库页的查询栏收成「搜索 + 一个筛选胶囊」，筛选、排序、只看收藏都收进那个胶囊里，手机上搜索和筛选也只用一行；词表里不再显示复习状态和日期，每行只剩词、释义和收藏、朗读两个按钮。统计页顶部的「开始复习」按钮去掉了。另外修掉两个动效问题：进页面时整页会跳一下再淡入一次，鼠标划过词条会闪一下暗灰——前者是入场动画结束时换了控件结构、把整棵子树重建了，后者是补间起点用了透明黑。
en: The interface was rebuilt on a new layout: lists sit directly on the paper, separated by hairlines and one vertical accent rule, instead of stacking cards; buttons, fields and chips are now capsules. All eight screens lost their title bar and subtitle — the sidebar and tab bar already name the page, so the title only repeated it and cost a full strip of height. The words page folds its query row into "search + one filter capsule" that carries status, sort and favourites, so search and filter share a single line on a phone too; the list no longer shows review status or due dates, and each row is just the word, its gloss, and favourite/listen. The "start review" button at the top of stats is gone. Two motion bugs are fixed as well: entering a page made it jump and fade in twice, and hovering a word flashed dark grey — the first because the entrance animation swapped its widget structure when it finished and remounted the subtree, the second because the hover tween started from transparent black.
